# Version 4.156.3 (Unreleased)
> **Rendering correctness and native safety**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.156.3 brings upstream fixes for image filtering, glyph cropping and native rendering bounds. This unreleased servicing update stays on Skia m156 and preserves the managed API and native ABI.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Ganesh image filtering and destination reads** — Prevents image filters from sampling unwritten scratch texels through mipmaps and clips destination reads to their intended bounds when geometry overshoots draw bounds. ([#5837](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5837))
- **FreeType LCD glyph cropping** — Corrects pixel-space bounds and overlap cropping when successive glyph loads produce different outlines, avoiding misaligned LCD16 copies and assertions. Outline translation is also checked for overflow. ([#5837](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5837))
- **Ganesh buffer-allocation bounds** — Checks allocation, alignment and padding arithmetic to prevent overflow and out-of-bounds writes. Invalid or failed allocations skip the draw instead of using an invalid buffer. ([#5837](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5837))
- **Graphite painter order after overwrites** — Resets depth and bounds tracking when a draw overwrites earlier output, preventing repeated overwrites from wrapping depth and changing painter order. ([#5837](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5837))
